notes: IRPEF brackets: three-bracket structure per L. 199/2025 (Legge di Bilancio 2026); second bracket reduced from 35% to 33% effective 2026-01-01. Sterilization of detrazioni for redditi > 200,000 EUR (Art. 1 co. 3-4 L. 199/2025) is out of scope for this engine (see separate fiscal library).

work_deduction_breakpoints: Art. 13 co. 1 TUIR, as modified by D.Lgs. 216/2023 and confirmed by L. 207/2024 (Legge di Bilancio 2025). Breakpoints represent the piecewise-linear deduction schedule: flat at EUR 1,955 for income <= 8,500; linear from 1,955 to 700 in the 8,500-28,000 range; linear from 700 to 0 in the 28,000-50,000 range; zero above 50,000.

INPS rates for pubblici dipendenti (CTPS — Cassa Trattamenti Pensionistici dei dipendenti dello Stato): employee 8.80%, employer 24.20%, total 33.00%. Confirmed from kitech.it (https://www.kitech.it/Contributi-previdenziali.aspx?p=17_210) and corroborated by INPS sources (33% total = 8.80% employee + 24.20% employer for CTPS, per INPS Gestione Dipendenti Pubblici). NOTE: other ex-INPDAP sub-funds differ — CPDEL/CPS/CPI total 32.65% (employee 8.85%, employer 23.80%); military, healthcare, and school sub-funds may vary. PA contracts mapped in this engine target CTPS-insured employees (civil servants); other sub-funds would require separate data.

fixed_term_additional_rate: 0.000 — Pubblica Amministrazione is explicitly excluded from the NASpI addizionale (lavoratori delle pubbliche amministrazioni are in the statutory exclusion list per INPS guidance; source: nexumstp.it citing INPS rules). PA fixed-term contracts do not attract the 1.4% addizionale that applies to private-sector employers.

SIMPLIFICATION: apprentice block is a schema-required placeholder (same rates as employee/employer); apprendistato is not applicable to PA contracts under D.Lgs. 165/2001 and no CCNL track will reference these values.

Sterilizzazione detrazioni: Art. 1 c. 3-4 L. 199/2025 — for reddito complessivo > EUR 200 000, total detrazioni (Art. 12 + Art. 13 TUIR) reduced by EUR 440 (clawback of the 35% -> 33% bracket benefit on the 28 000-50 000 slice).
